quests.name: Armorcrafting
quests.offer: So you would work the forge? Every suit of armor begins with ore and a mold. I will give you a novice's hammer, a recipe and what it takes. Make a pair of blacksmith's bracers and show them to me. Will you learn?
quests.accept: I will learn the forge.
quests.declined: The forge will be here when you are ready.
quests.started: Hold the hammer, read the recipe, then open your recipe book under Armor and make the bracers from the crude iron, the mold and my emblem. Show them to me when they are done.

steps.journal: Make a pair of blacksmith's bracers and show them to Smithy Vargis.
steps.notyet: Not yet. Hold the hammer, read the recipe, and make the bracers from your recipe book.
steps.says: Good work. Every armorsmith begins with a pair of those. Buy ore and molds by the forge and experiment: ore and a mold make a piece, and a gem or an alloy makes it more. A better hammer works finer metal.

quests.notes: eqoatrade.com's armor tutorial (2003-04): the trainer's kit and the first recipe. The words are ours.

quests.name: Jewelcrafting
quests.offer: You have a careful eye. Every ring begins with a metal, a mold and a gem, but a jeweler begins with glass. Take this kit, a recipe and enough to start. Make a glass trinket and show it to me. Will you learn?
quests.accept: I will learn the jeweler's craft.
quests.declined: The gems will keep. Come back when your hands are steady.
quests.started: Hold the kit, read the recipe, then open your recipe book under Jewelry and make the trinket from the glass and the pendant mold, under Special. Show it to me when it is done.

steps.journal: Make a glass trinket and show it to Jeweler Gratyll.
steps.notyet: Not yet. Hold the kit, read the recipe, and make the trinket from your recipe book.
steps.says: A fine first piece. Now experiment: the cracked glass, the earring mold and the iron bar make something too. A bar, a mold and a gem make a piece, and finer metal needs a finer kit. A failed combine keeps the gem.

quests.notes: eqoatrade.com's jewelry tutorial (2003-04): the trainer's kit, the glass trinket recipe and the cracked glass earring found by experiment. The words are ours.
